__spec__.what: The shared layer-1 synthetic data source. One file, every language. Content only — no dynamics, no language.
__spec__.ruled: layer 1 ruled by the owner 2026-08-15 (node_0_3_4 CORE): seven content forms + nesting + identity marks; complete-for-content by the serialization argument; behavior excluded to layer 3.

conventions.specials: JSON cannot hold NaN/Infinity/-0.0 distinctly, so a special is spelled as an object {"#special": "<name>"}. The harness generator replaces it with the language's spelling. Names: nan, inf, -inf, -0.0.
conventions.identity: An anchor is spelled {"#anchor": "<id>", "value": <element>}. A reference to it is {"#ref": "<id>"}. Two positions holding the same id name ONE node. A #ref may point at an enclosing #anchor (a cycle).
conventions.big_integers: Whole numbers past IEEE-double exactness are spelled as strings under {"#int": "<decimal>"} so no JSON parser silently rounds them. The generator emits them as native integer literals (or the language's arithmetic construction where literals refuse, per the dart-web finding, log_020 postscript).

__spec__.edge_provenance: Edge values are the census fracture lists (census_*.md, verified log_019/log_020). Nothing invented; every edge exists because it made languages disagree.

whole.edge_notes: i64 max; i64 max+1 (overflow edge); i64 min; 2^53+1 (float-exactness edge: typescript/dart-web erosion); u64 max (unsigned-camp edge).

fractional.edge_notes: negative zero (probed via sign of 1/x, log_019 lesson); NaN (self-inequality); infinities; near-overflow; smallest subnormal; the classic non-representable decimal.

text.edge_notes: empty; the e-acute (1 codepoint / 1 utf16 unit / 2 utf8 bytes) and the musical clef U+1D11E (1 / 2 / 4) — the three-lengths fracture, F-s1/F-s3; embedded quote, backslash, tab, newline.

sequence.edge_notes: empty; singleton; homogeneous; nested; MIXED types (splits the declared-element-type camp, F-l1); unsorted (sort probes); duplicates.

keyed.edge_notes: empty; flat; nested; the integer-LIKE string key (js coercion edge, F-d1); insertion order differing from sorted order (F-d2 order probes); empty-string key. A MISSING key is a probe act, not data: probes ask for key "absent".

shared_node.note: left and right are ONE sequence. Edit through left, read through right — the share/copy/move fracture (F-l9) made observable by the data itself.

cycle.note: a node containing itself. Representations that refuse cycles refuse HERE, loudly — that refusal is a layer-2 audit finding, not an error.
